_about: Design tokens for clau-garm, a VFR EFB. Dark theme is primary: an EFB is used in a cockpit in daylight glare and at night, and Garmin's own manual calls out glare and brightness. These are role tokens, not copied from Garmin (we have no screenshots). accent is a neutral grey placeholder; replica-brand picks the brand hue. The map.* tokens follow standard aviation colour conventions (weather flight-category colours, terrain caution/warning, airspace), which are industry convention and not Garmin's trade dress. Colours stored for the dark theme; a light/day theme is a later variant. Check with: python3 <pack>/replica-design/contrast.py replica/design/tokens.json

map._about: Semantic map colours following aviation convention, not Garmin. Flight-category colours are the FAA/industry VFR/MVFR/IFR/LIFR set; terrain caution/warning are the standard amber/red.

touch.comment: min 48dp; cockpit use with gloves and turbulence
